requirement:
Build a Python FastAPI URL shortener with SQLite, unique short codes, HTTP 302 redirects, aggregate click counts, and pytest tests under tests/.
Clarification: Use server-generated codes only; no custom aliases. Create a new unique code for every submission, even for duplicate URLs. Store only aggregate click counts, with no per-click timestamps, referrers, or visitor identifiers. Accept only HTTP and HTTPS URLs. Generate seven-character case-sensitive alphanumeric codes using secure randomness, enforce uniqueness in SQLite, and retry collisions with a bounded limit. Use POST /links, GET /r/{code}, and GET /links/{code}/stats.
